2026_01_TB_CIN.headline: Cincinnati’s receiving continuity meets a Tampa Bay unit carrying multiple doubtful tags
2026_01_TB_CIN.paragraph1: The Buccaneers list Jalen McMillan, Sean Tucker and Justin Skule as doubtful, with Christian Rozeboom questionable, while the Bengals have Shemar Stewart doubtful and their primary veteran receivers carrying no game designation. Tampa Bay therefore enters with more potential disruption across skill and protection depth. Cincinnati can press that issue by forcing the Buccaneers to defend the full width of the field, while Tampa Bay needs Baker Mayfield to avoid obvious passing downs and protect a thinner supporting cast.
2026_01_TB_CIN.model_rationale: Cincinnati’s healthier offensive core should create more answers across formations, especially if Tampa Bay’s depleted depth forces conservative protection choices and narrower personnel packages.
